notes.title: Patch 1.1202 out now
notes.notes:
New patch v1.1202 is out now for PC and macOS with minor fixes for the game and preparation for new content (later this year).

Fixes include:
[olist]
Rover disappearing from main base when the player visits the Mars Ranch and comes back.
Player is able to purchase the same rocket parts multiple times.
In chef mode, the player's own ingredients aren't used in the final calculations and not deducted properly.
Game crashes when placing water bucket in Mars Ranch.
Player cannot add food to the animals bucket (when its been resorted).
[/olist]

Please visit our Discord if you have any other issues or need some help - https://discord.com/invite/HywrrEBzeN.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1
notes.notes:
The new patch 1.1 Mars Ranch update will be dropping in January. It’ll feature the ability for the players to raise and breed animal livestock, then eventually run a mini petting zoo or sell them off to the markets.

This new Mars Ranch level features indoor and outdoor areas as well. There will even be new props for the Ranch and the home pod interior!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40884532/65936fb25dd4c0e40a149ce20aea62b5221f311c.png

There are three new buildings: Mars Barn, Coop and Train Loop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40884532/1b4a6b79157c4a89bbaee5065573f228cfde95e5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40884532/a35a267383ffed50608298db85ee0c37ac1963bf.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40884532/9ed545e613a3913cc720e9869221a51b6c54b7e3.png

You can store animals in the barn and coop, and travel using the train loop!

New animals include cows, goats, sheep, pigs, chicken and rabbits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40884532/0a1c53974067b5d6322f90cdd5abc2632647a5f0.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40884532/bbbb824a9038b54c9900439d7f38f3cdce6f5f4d.png

New animals can be stored in the barn and coop!

For some quality of life updates, we have added a new Mars wood resource, as well as inventory enhancements. 

We’ve done a lot of work on the back end with bug fixes, updates, and more, so we hope you’ll check out the update in January! If you have any feedback or want more updates, check out our Discord and Twitter.

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.024
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We've got another patch for you all today continuing to address the bugs you all have found. We've also added in some more quality of life stuff, like mouse support menu interactions! 

We're also working on our first big content patch that we want to tease a little bit for you all!

Welcome to the wild west of Mars Base, a new enclosed biome to explore and new resources to salvage. In the effort of sustaining future colonies, you are tasked with setting up a ranch to acquire animal livestock from Earth. You will raise them up, and then move them on to the Mars zoo or sell them off to the markets. The base inhabitants can visit the zoo for recreational purposes and earn you additional income in the process. Lastly, there will be new buildings, interior and exterior props to engineer. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40884532/1b2dfa0d0660fdab36226aaf5819b07ff55c01e2.png

The Mars Ranch patch will be landing soon. Now onto v1.024 patch notes!

Addtions/Fixes: 

 Fixed crash if player is carrying crop seeds and interacts with bun.ie droid in the greenhouses.
 Fixed crash when swapping weapons in the Dungeon.
 Added transparency when the player walks behind a building or machine.
 Added mouse support for Build, Freedom, Terrain and Planter mode. The mouse can move or select objects within the camera view now.
 Added mouse support for all menu interactions.
 Added mouse right click support to open the menu throughout the game.
 Added mouse left click to shoot in the dungeons if any enemies exist.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.015
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We've got another patch for you all today updating and adding some things, as well as fixing some more of the issues that you all have been reporting. Please keep the reviews and feedback coming. We love reading through it all, plus it will help us continue improving the game! If you run into any issues or want to send more feedback than what you want to include in a review, feel free to post in our discussion boards, or in our Discord! 

Updates/Fixes

 Fixed soft lock issue with recycling the buildings or machines.
 Allow camera to zoom out when in Freedom or Terrain mode.
 Fixed camera issue where it prevented the player from moving or placing objects closer to the edge of the map.
 Fixed issue with non-pistol weapons not equiping properly in the dungeons.
 Fixed low energy darkness levels so it won't get darker each time.
 Fixed camera zoom setting before and after going to bed.
 Fixed oxygen and water machines max levels as you recycle the respective machines.
 Added Inventory key 'i' which will load straight the player straight into the blueprint or items inventory depending where they are.
 Added 'exit' button to the market or forging menus.
 Updated shop functions so it won't sell blueprints or recipes that the player have already.
 Updated enemy stats (knock back, speed and hp) in the dungeons.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.013
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 
We have our first patch for you all! Please keep the feedback coming! We love hearing from our community and will continue improving the game. This first patch addresses some of the crashes and bugs that we've seen reported. If you have encountered any more bugs along your journey on Mars, please report it in our Discord. 

Fixes:

 Fixed crash that occurred when players obtained 24 out of the 25 rocket parts and then went to sleep.
 Fixed sound bug where it keeps looping if player drives it around and then exits the Rover.
 Fixed animation glitch with the bike rover when driving right.
 Fixed Rover issue not appearing in the open plains after exiting the Rover, leaving the area and then coming back.


We are still working on some other bugs and such that have been reported. Thank you for your patience with us in the meantime!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey botanists! We have some very exciting news for you all today!

We’ll be making a landing onto Mars on Oct 3rd, 2022 on PC! 

[previewyoutube=-maF0EButew;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: July Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hello adventures! 
Our playtest went extremely well. We’re thankful to have a great community to help us beta test and provide amazing feedback. Plenty of bug fixes and enhancements are coming thanks to players just like you - we’re so grateful for the community support! If you’d like to join the community and let us know what your ideas are, you can always join our Discord, follow us on Twitter, and check us out on Instagram. 

We’re currently working on our finishing touches so we can share with not just you all, but the world, Mars Base.

Speaking of sharing… it’s always the most fun to share food! Here’s some peeks into the culinary world of Mars Base.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40884532/44c4648da5406ba958d6d9824c4f447739578293.png

This is a farm on the base where we grow all the veggies we’ll need.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40884532/f1a26ecc35a4fbea96df7f52f4fb084ec4171d21.png

Talking to Akari, she says she misses fried chicken. Fried chicken sounds delicious, but not as delicious as some of these dishes we can cook here on the base!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40884532/47172b1d8a412051b24fe5ecf07b8906859a3e72.png

Tofu is soy milk that has been coagulated, with the curds being pressed into blocks. It can be eaten in so many ways - fried, uncooked, boiled, scrambled, roasted...or in ramen!
Speaking of ramen…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40884532/1b639b0ef589e9821746598595905c922f478936.png

This dish is unique to Mars! Mars Ramen is renowned for its savory broth, chewy noodles, and tasty toppings. 

Last, but not least, let’s introduce kaisendon - a combination of tuna and shrimp sashimi, and sushi rice. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40884532/0a140198c16005151b77f45665cb4f6a62757d35.png

This looks delicious!

We have over 30 unique dishes and recipes you can create. Make sure to keep us updated on what YOU decide to make!

Stay tuned for more (delicious) information, and as always, we’ll see you next time!

Quick Shoutout! 
We previously had Mars Base on Kickstarter and were successful with our campaign, so we'd like to give a shoutout to a fellow Freedom Games title, Troublemaker that recently launched on IndieGoGo! 

Grab a backpack, boxing tape, and focus on what high school is all about: Beating the ever loving crap out of one another! Troublemaker brings favorite action-adventure-beat-'em-up elements from the strongest traditions in the genre.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40884532/46a19d25c8d6e38b4a6a8ab27d1a777cdf0090bf.jpg

Show them some support and love, especially if it looks like your kind of game 😊

Many thanks, 
Khuong
